seoTitle: Logfmt Parser: key=value Logs to JSON, Table or CSV
metaDescription: Convert logfmt lines from Heroku, Go and other services into JSON, a table or CSV. Quoted values and typed numbers supported. Free.
intro: Parses key=value logfmt lines into objects and prints them as JSON, JSON lines, a table or CSV.
why:
Logfmt is compact for people but awkward for tools. Converting it to JSON or CSV lets you use jq, spreadsheets or other viewers.

Quoted values with escapes are supported. Numbers and true or false can be converted to types. Words without an equals sign are ignored unless you ask to keep them.
howTo: Paste logfmt lines or choose a file.
Turn typing of numbers on or off.

faq.a: Only if you tick the option. They become key=true.

faq.q: Does it handle a prefix before the pairs?
faq.a: Words before the first pair are ignored, so syslog-style prefixes do not break it.
